Gadkari Challenges Critics on E20 Petrol's Impact on Cars

Union Minister Nitin Gadkari has challenged individuals claiming that E20 petrol causes problems in cars. He invited them to name even one petrol vehicle that has been damaged by using ethanol-blended fuel. This statement comes amidst discussions and potential concerns regarding the use of higher ethanol blends in petrol.
